name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Classic Italian pasta with rich beef mince sauce
instructions: Dice onion, carrot and celery. Mince garlic.
Heat oil in pan, sauté onion until soft.
Add garlic, carrot and celery, cook 3 mins.
Brown the mince, breaking it up.
Add crushed tomatoes, oregano, simmer 20 mins.
Cook spaghetti per packet. Serve topped with parmesan.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Stir-fry
description: Quick and healthy stir-fry with tender chicken and crisp veggies
instructions: Slice chicken into thin strips. Chop vegetables.
Cook rice per packet instructions.
Heat wok over high heat with oil.
Stir-fry chicken until golden, set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables until tender-crisp.
Return chicken, add sauces and cornflour mix, toss to coat.
Serve over rice.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Creamy and aromatic Indian-inspired chicken curry
instructions: Marinate chicken in yoghurt and garam masala for 30 mins.
Cook rice per packet instructions.
Fry onion and garlic until softened.
Add chicken, cook until browned.
Pour in sauce, simmer 15 mins.
Stir in cream, simmer 5 more mins.
Serve with rice and warm naan.

name: Salmon with Roasted Vegetables
description: Pan-seared salmon fillet with colourful roasted vegies
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Chop zucchini and toss all veggies with oil and garlic on a baking tray.
Roast vegetables 20 mins until caramelised.
Season salmon with salt, pepper, and dill.
Pan-sear salmon 3-4 mins each side.
Serve salmon over roasted vegetables with lemon wedge.

name: Beef and Vegetable Soup
description: Hearty, warming soup with tender beef and root vegetables
instructions: Cut beef into 3cm chunks, season with salt and pepper.
Brown beef in batches in a large pot, set aside.
Sauté onion and celery until soft.
Add beef back with stock, tomato paste, bay leaves and thyme.
Simmer 40 mins until beef is tender.
Add carrots and potatoes, cook another 15 mins.
Serve with crusty bread.

name: Veggie Fried Rice
description: Quick and tasty fried rice loaded with vegetables
instructions: Dice carrot, slice spring onions.
Heat wok over high heat with oil.
Scramble eggs, push to side.
Add garlic, carrot and corn, stir-fry 2 mins.
Add rice, breaking up any clumps.
Add frozen peas, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss everything together, top with spring onions.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs
description: Crispy skin chicken thighs cooked in the air fryer
instructions: Pat chicken dry, coat in oil and spices.
Preheat air fryer to 200°C.
Cook chicken thighs 20-25 mins until skin is crispy.
Cube and roast sweet potato in the oven.
Serve with salad and sweet potato.

name: Prawn Tacos
description: Zesty prawns in soft tortillas with slaw and avocado
instructions: Shred red cabbage, mix with lime juice.
Season prawns with cumin and paprika.
Cook prawns in hot pan 2-3 mins each side.
Mash avocado with lime juice.
Warm tortillas.
Assemble tacos with cabbage, prawns, avocado and sour cream.
Top with coriander and jalapeño.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce — a great brekky or dinner
instructions: Sauté onion and capsicum until soft.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli, cook 1 min.
Add crushed tomatoes, simmer 10 mins.
Make wells in sauce, crack eggs in.
Cover and cook until eggs set to your liking.
Top with crumbled feta and serve with bread.

name: Lemon Herb Baked Fish
description: Light and healthy baked fish with fresh herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Boil potatoes until tender.
Place fish in baking dish, top with lemon, garlic, capers and oil.
Bake 15-18 mins until flaky.
Steam green beans.
Garnish with fresh parsley, serve with potatoes and beans.

name: Lamb Kofta with Tzatziki
description: Spiced lamb mince skewers with cool yoghurt dip
instructions: Mix lamb mince with garlic, cumin and coriander.
Shape into oval patties around skewers.
Grate cucumber, squeeze dry, mix into yoghurt with mint and lemon.
Grill kofta 8-10 mins, turning.
Warm pita bread.
Serve kofta with tzatziki, salad and pita.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Classic Caesar with grilled chicken and crunchy croutons
instructions: Cube bread and bake until golden croutons.
Season and grill chicken, slice when rested.
Cook bacon until crispy.
Tear lettuce into bowl.
Add chicken, bacon, croutons.
Toss with Caesar dressing and top with parmesan.

name: One-Pan Sausage and Veggie Bake
description: Easy weeknight dinner — everything roasted together
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Toss vegetables with oil and seasoning on a large baking tray.
Nestle sausages among vegetables.
Bake 40-45 mins until sausages are cooked and veg is golden.

name: Tuna Pasta Bake
description: Comforting creamy pasta bake with tuna and corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Cook pasta until al dente.
Drain tuna and mix with soup, milk, corn and peas.
Combine with pasta and spring onions.
Pour into baking dish, top with cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake 25 mins until golden and bubbling.

name: BBQ Pork Ribs
description: Fall-off-the-bone ribs with smoky BBQ glaze
instructions: Mix dry rub and coat ribs, marinate 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 160°C.
Wrap ribs in foil and bake 1.5 hours.
Unwrap, brush with BBQ sauce, grill 10 mins until caramelised.
Boil corn cobs and toss with butter.
Serve ribs with coleslaw and corn.

name: Greek Salad with Grilled Halloumi
description: Fresh Mediterranean salad with salty golden halloumi
instructions: Chop cucumber, halve tomatoes, slice red onion.
Combine vegetables with olives and feta.
Dress with oil, lemon juice and oregano.
Slice halloumi and grill in dry pan 1-2 mins each side.
Serve salad topped with grilled halloumi and warm pita.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Comforting homestyle soup with tender chicken and egg noodles
instructions: Bring stock to boil with whole chicken breast.
Add diced onion, carrot, celery and garlic.
Cook chicken 20 mins, remove and shred.
Return shredded chicken to pot.
Add noodles and thyme, cook per noodle packet.
Season to taste and top with fresh parsley.

name: Teriyaki Salmon Bowl
description: Japanese-inspired salmon bowl with sticky teriyaki glaze
instructions: Mix soy, honey and mirin for teriyaki sauce.
Cook rice per packet.
Marinate salmon in half the sauce 10 mins.
Cook salmon 3-4 mins each side, add remaining sauce.
Assemble bowls with rice, salmon, edamame, cucumber and avocado.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and spring onions.

name: Classic Pumpkin Soup
description: Silky smooth roasted pumpkin soup with crusty bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Cube pumpkin, toss with oil and roast 30 mins.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add roasted pumpkin, stock and nutmeg.
Blitz with stick blender until smooth.
Stir in cream, season well.
Serve with crusty bread.

name: Beef Soft Tacos
description: Juicy seasoned beef in corn tortillas with fresh toppings
instructions: Brown beef mince in pan.
Add taco seasoning and a splash of water, simmer 5 mins.
Warm tortillas.
Mash avocado with lime juice.
Set up toppings — lettuce, cheese, sour cream, salsa.
Fill tortillas and serve immediately.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken
description: Sweet and sticky chicken thighs with a 5-ingredient sauce
instructions: Cook rice per packet.
Sear chicken thighs skin-side down 5-6 mins, flip and cook 3 mins.
Mix honey, garlic, soy and vinegar.
Pour sauce over chicken, cook 5 mins, basting frequently.
Steam broccoli.
Serve chicken with sauce over rice and broccoli.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy Italian risotto with mixed mushrooms and parmesan
instructions: Keep stock warm in saucepan.
Sauté onion and garlic in butter and oil.
Slice and cook mushrooms until golden, set aside.
Add rice and toast 1 min.
Add wine, stir until absorbed.
Add stock ladle by ladle, stirring constantly 20 mins.
Stir in mushrooms, butter and parmesan. Season well.

name: Pad Thai
description: Classic Thai noodles with prawns, peanuts and lime
instructions: Soak noodles in warm water per packet.
Heat wok over high heat.
Stir-fry prawns until pink, set aside.
Scramble eggs in wok.
Add noodles and sauce, toss to coat.
Return prawns, add bean sprouts and spring onions.
Serve with crushed peanuts, lime and coriander.

name: Vegetable Dahl
description: Warming spiced red lentil and vegetable curry
instructions: Fry onion, garlic and ginger until soft.
Add curry powder, cook 1 min.
Add lentils, stock, coconut milk and tomatoes.
Simmer 25 mins until lentils are soft.
Stir through spinach until wilted.
Serve over basmati rice.

name: Pulled Pork Sliders
description: Slow-cooked pulled pork on soft slider buns
instructions: Warm pulled pork with BBQ sauce in pan.
Mix coleslaw with mayo and vinegar.
Toast slider buns.
Pile pulled pork onto buns.
Top with coleslaw and pickles.

name: Air Fryer Fish and Chips
description: Crispy battered fish and chips without the deep fryer
instructions: Cut potatoes into chips, spray with oil, air fry at 200°C 20 mins, shaking halfway.
Set up flour, beaten egg and panko crumbs.
Coat fish in flour, egg, then panko.
Air fry fish 12-15 mins until golden.
Serve with tartar sauce, lemon and salad.

name: Chicken Fajitas
description: Sizzling spiced chicken strips with colourful capsicum
instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables into strips.
Toss chicken in fajita seasoning.
Sear chicken in hot pan until cooked, set aside.
Cook capsicum and onion in same pan until tender.
Return chicken, add lime juice.
Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream, cheese and salsa.

name: Lentil and Vegetable Stew
description: Thick and hearty plant-based stew with a smoky depth
instructions: Dice all vegetables.
Sauté onion, carrot and celery until soft.
Add garlic, paprika and cumin, cook 1 min.
Add lentils, tomatoes and stock.
Add sweet potato, simmer 30 mins until lentils are tender.
Season and serve with crusty bread.

name: Chicken Schnitzel with Potato Salad
description: Crispy golden chicken schnitzel with potato salad
instructions: Boil potatoes, cool and dice. Mix with mayo and capers.
Pound chicken flat. Coat in flour, egg, breadcrumbs.
Shallow fry in hot oil 3-4 mins each side until golden.
Drain on paper towel.
Serve with potato salad, greens and lemon.

name: Air Fryer Pork Belly
description: Crackling pork belly strips in the air fryer
instructions: Pat pork dry, score skin, rub with vinegar, five spice and salt.
Air fry at 200°C 35-40 mins until crackling is crispy.
Cook rice and halve bok choy, stir-fry with oyster sauce.
Slice pork and serve with rice and bok choy.
Garnish with spring onions.

name: Chilli Con Carne
description: Rich, smoky beef and bean chilli — a crowd pleaser
instructions: Brown beef mince in large pot, remove and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Return beef, add spices, cook 1 min.
Add tomatoes, stock and beans.
Simmer 30-40 mins, stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice topped with sour cream and cheese.

name: Asian Noodle Salad
description: Cold noodle salad with crunchy vegetables and sesame dressing
instructions: Cook noodles per packet, rinse under cold water.
Shred cabbage and carrot, slice cucumber.
Mix soy, sesame oil and vinegar for dressing.
Toss noodles with vegetables and dressing.
Top with peanuts, coriander and spring onions.

name: Steak with Chimichurri
description: Perfectly seared steak with vibrant Argentine herb sauce
instructions: Blitz parsley, garlic, vinegar, oil and chilli for chimichurri.
Boil and mash potatoes with butter.
Season steaks generously with salt and pepper.
Sear on high heat 2-4 mins each side depending on thickness.
Rest 5 mins before slicing.
Serve with mash, beans and chimichurri drizzled over.

name: Frittata
description: Baked Italian egg dish packed with vegetables and cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Sauté onion and capsicum in oven-safe frying pan.
Add spinach until wilted.
Beat eggs with milk, herbs and crumbled feta.
Pour egg mix over vegetables, arrange tomatoes on top.
Cook on stove until sides set, then bake 15-18 mins until puffed and golden.
Serve with crusty bread.

name: Green Curry with Tofu
description: Fragrant Thai green curry with silken tofu and vegetables
instructions: Press tofu and cut into cubes, fry until golden.
Cook rice per packet.
Fry curry paste 1 min in pan.
Add coconut milk and stock, bring to simmer.
Add vegetables, cook 5-8 mins.
Add tofu and basil.
Serve over rice.

name: Moroccan Chicken
description: Aromatic chicken with preserved lemon, olives and apricots
instructions: Season chicken with ras el hanout.
Brown chicken on all sides.
Sauté onion and garlic, add spice, cook 1 min.
Return chicken, add stock, preserved lemon, olives and apricots.
Cover and simmer 30 mins.
Prepare couscous per packet.
Garnish with coriander and serve over couscous.

name: Nachos
description: Loaded nachos with all the toppings — great for sharing
instructions: Brown mince, add taco seasoning and beans.
Spread chips on baking tray.
Top with meat mixture and cheese.
Bake 10-12 mins at 180°C until cheese melts.
Add sour cream, guacamole and salsa.
Garnish with jalapeño and coriander.

name: Baked Ricotta Pasta
description: Creamy ricotta-stuffed pasta shells baked in tomato sauce
instructions: Cook pasta shells until al dente, drain.
Wilt spinach with garlic, chop roughly.
Mix ricotta, spinach, parmesan and eggs.
Spread sauce in baking dish.
Fill shells with ricotta mix, arrange in dish.
Top with mozzarella, bake 25 mins at 180°C until golden.

name: Miso Glazed Eggplant
description: Japanese-style roasted eggplant with sweet miso glaze
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Halve eggplants lengthwise, score flesh.
Mix miso, mirin, sesame oil and vinegar.
Brush miso glaze on eggplant, roast 25 mins.
Cook rice and edamame.
Top with sesame seeds and spring onions.

name: Beef Rendang
description: Rich Malaysian dry curry with slow-cooked tender beef
instructions: Cut beef into large chunks.
Toast desiccated coconut until golden.
Fry rendang paste with onion, garlic and ginger.
Add beef, lemongrass, lime leaves and coconut milk.
Simmer low and slow 1.5-2 hours until sauce is dark and thick.
Stir in toasted coconut. Serve with rice.

name: Haloumi Wrap
description: Crispy halloumi with roasted veggies in a wholegrain wrap
instructions: Slice halloumi and grill in dry pan until golden.
Warm wraps.
Spread hummus on wraps.
Layer spinach, tomatoes, capsicum and onion.
Add halloumi, squeeze lemon juice.
Roll up tightly and serve.

name: Pesto Pasta with Grilled Chicken
description: Fresh basil pesto tossed through pasta with juicy grilled chicken
instructions: Cook pasta per packet, reserve ¼ cup pasta water.
Season and grill chicken, slice when rested.
Toss pasta with pesto, pasta water and halved tomatoes.
Add chicken, toss to combine.
Top with parmesan, pine nuts and fresh basil.

name: Slow Cooker Lamb Shanks
description: Fall-off-the-bone lamb in red wine and herb broth
instructions: Brown shanks on all sides, place in slow cooker.
Sauté onion, carrot and garlic, add to cooker.
Pour wine, stock and tomatoes over, add herbs.
Cook on low 7-8 hours.
Make mashed potato.
Serve shanks over mash with braising liquid as sauce.

name: Spring Rolls
description: Crispy veggie spring rolls baked or air-fried
instructions: Soak vermicelli per packet, drain and chop.
Shred cabbage and carrot, slice mushrooms.
Stir-fry vegetables with soy sauce and sesame oil, cool.
Mix in noodles and bean sprouts.
Fill wrappers with 2 tbsp filling, roll tightly.
Spray with oil, air fry 200°C 15-18 mins until golden.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

name: Avocado Chicken Wraps
description: Speedy wraps with grilled chicken, avocado and salad
instructions: Season chicken with paprika, salt and pepper.
Pan-fry chicken over high heat 4-5 mins each side until cooked through.
Rest and slice chicken.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread avocado on tortillas, top with chicken, spinach and tomatoes.
Drizzle with yoghurt, fold and serve immediately.

name: Quick Tuna Pasta Bake
description: Pantry-staple pasta bake ready in a flash
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cook pasta until al dente.
Mix soup with milk in a large bowl.
Drain tuna, add with peas, pasta and half the cheese.
Pour into baking dish, top with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake 15 mins until golden and bubbling.
Scatter spring onions and serve.

name: Mee Goreng
description: Malaysian-style spicy fried noodles — faster than takeaway
instructions: Heat wok with oil over high heat.
Fry garlic 30 secs, push to side and scramble eggs.
Add noodles, kecap manis, soy and sambal, toss well.
Add beansprouts and toss 1 more minute.
Plate and top with spring onions and fried shallots.

name: Classic Chicken Schnitzel
description: Golden crumbed chicken schnitzel — an Aussie pub classic
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness.
Set up three bowls: flour, beaten egg, breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan.
Coat each piece in flour, egg, then crumbs.
Fry in hot oil 3-4 mins each side until golden.
Drain on paper towel.
Serve with lemon wedges and salad.

name: Thai Basil Mince
description: Punchy Thai larb-inspired mince bowl ready in 15 minutes
instructions: Cook rice per packet instructions.
Fry garlic and chilli in hot oil 30 secs.
Add mince, break up and cook until browned.
Add fish sauce, oyster sauce and sugar, toss.
Remove from heat, stir through basil.
Fry eggs sunny-side up. Serve mince over rice topped with egg.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
description: Rich and earthy mushroom pasta — no meat, maximum flavour
instructions: Cook pasta per packet instructions, reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Sauté mushrooms in butter over high heat until golden.
Add garlic and thyme, cook 1 min.
Deglaze with wine, reduce by half.
Stir in cream, simmer 3 mins.
Toss with pasta, adding pasta water to loosen.
Serve topped with parmesan.

name: Korean Beef Bowl
description: Sweet and savoury Korean-style beef over steamed rice
instructions: Cook rice per packet instructions.
Mix soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger.
Brown mince in hot pan, breaking up well.
Pour sauce over mince, cook 3-4 mins until sticky.
Serve beef over rice, topped with spring onions and sesame seeds.

name: Fish Tacos
description: Light and fresh battered fish tacos with slaw
instructions: Season fish with cumin, paprika, salt and pepper.
Pan-fry fish 3-4 mins each side, flake into chunks.
Shred cabbage, squeeze with lime juice.
Mash avocado with lime juice and salt.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Assemble: guac, fish, slaw, sour cream, coriander.

name: Prawn Stir-fry
description: Garlic and ginger prawns tossed with vegetables and rice
instructions: Cook rice per packet instructions.
Heat wok over very high heat.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger 30 secs.
Add prawns, cook 2-3 mins until pink.
Add vegetables, stir-fry 2 mins.
Add oyster sauce and sesame oil, toss well.
Serve over rice.

name: Teriyaki Salmon
description: Sticky teriyaki glazed salmon with steamed greens
instructions: Mix soy sauce, honey, mirin and garlic for teriyaki sauce.
Cook rice per packet instructions. Steam broccolini.
Pan-fry salmon skin-side down 4 mins, flip 2 mins.
Pour teriyaki sauce over, baste until sticky.
Serve over rice with greens, sprinkle sesame seeds.

name: Lamb Souvlaki Wraps
description: Greek-style marinated lamb in toasted pita with tzatziki
instructions: Mix lamb with oregano, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper.
Grill or pan-fry lamb 3-4 mins each side, rest and slice.
Make tzatziki: grate and squeeze cucumber, mix with yoghurt and garlic.
Warm pita bread in a pan.
Slice tomato and red onion.
Fill pita with lamb, tzatziki, tomato and onion.

name: Taco Bowl
description: Mexican-inspired beef taco bowl — quick and customisable
instructions: Cook rice per packet instructions.
Brown mince in a pan, add taco seasoning and splash of water.
Warm black beans in a small pot.
Halve cherry tomatoes, slice avocado.
Build bowl: rice, beef, beans, corn, tomato, avocado.
Top with sour cream and shredded cheese.

name: Chickpea Curry
description: Quick vegetarian curry packed with protein and flavour
instructions: Cook rice per packet instructions.
Fry onion and garlic 3 mins until soft.
Add spices, cook 1 min.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk, simmer 10 mins.
Stir through spinach until wilted.
Serve over rice.

name: Honey Mustard Chicken Traybake
description: One-tray weeknight wonder — honey mustard chicken with veggies
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Mix mustard, honey, garlic, oil, salt and pepper.
Halve potatoes, toss with half the sauce on a baking tray.
Coat chicken in remaining sauce, place on potatoes.
Roast 30 mins, add beans for last 10 mins.
Serve straight from the tray.

name: Zucchini Fritters
description: Cheesy zucchini fritters with a dollop of yoghurt
instructions: Grate zucchini, squeeze out all moisture in a cloth.
Mix with egg, flour, crumbled feta, spring onions and dill.
Season well with salt and pepper.
Pan-fry spoonfuls in oil 3 mins each side until golden.
Mix yoghurt with lemon juice.
Serve fritters with lemon yoghurt.

name: Prawn Laksa
description: Fragrant coconut laksa with plump prawns — a takeaway favourite
instructions: Soak rice noodles per packet, drain.
Fry laksa paste in pot 2 mins until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and stock, bring to simmer.
Add bok choy and prawns, cook 3-4 mins until prawns are pink.
Divide noodles between bowls, ladle over laksa broth.
Top with beansprouts, coriander and lime.

name: Lamb Cutlets with Mint Salad
description: Juicy grilled lamb cutlets with a bright tabbouleh-style salad
instructions: Season lamb with salt, pepper and olive oil.
Cook couscous per packet: pour boiling water, cover 5 mins, fluff.
Grill or pan-fry lamb 2-3 mins each side for medium.
Mix couscous with mint, parsley, halved tomatoes and cucumber.
Dress salad with lemon juice and olive oil.
Serve lamb over salad, scatter pomegranate seeds.

name: Cauliflower Fried Rice
description: Low-carb cauliflower rice with egg and vegetables
instructions: Blitz cauliflower in food processor to rice-sized pieces.
Dice carrot, slice spring onions.
Heat oil in wok, scramble eggs, set aside.
Stir-fry garlic and carrot 2 mins.
Add cauliflower, stir-fry 4 mins until lightly golden.
Add peas, soy sauce, sesame oil and eggs, toss together.
Top with spring onions.

name: Beef Burritos
description: Loaded beef burritos — better than a takeaway
instructions: Brown beef mince, add taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Warm beans in a small pot.
Mash avocado with salt and lime juice.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Layer rice, beef, beans, cheese, salsa, guacamole and sour cream.
Roll tightly, slice in half and serve.

name: Coconut Ginger Pumpkin Soup
description: Smooth, warming pumpkin soup with crusty bread
instructions: Peel and cube pumpkin.
Sauté onion, garlic and ginger 3 mins.
Add pumpkin, cumin and stock, bring to boil.
Simmer 20 mins until pumpkin is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender.
Stir in coconut cream, season and serve with crusty bread.

name: Soy Glazed Chicken Thighs
description: Sticky soy-glazed chicken thighs with steamed jasmine rice
instructions: Mix soy, honey, garlic and ginger.
Score chicken thighs, marinate 5 mins in sauce.
Cook rice per packet. Steam broccolini.
Cook chicken skin-side down 8 mins, flip, pour over remaining sauce.
Cook 8 more mins until caramelised and cooked through.
Serve over rice with broccolini, sprinkle sesame seeds.

name: Vegetable Frittata
description: Oven-baked egg frittata loaded with whatever veg is in the fridge
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Dice zucchini, capsicum and onion, sauté in oven-safe pan 5 mins.
Add spinach, cook until wilted.
Whisk eggs with milk, herbs, salt and pepper.
Pour egg mix over vegetables, crumble feta on top.
Bake 15-18 mins until set. Cut into wedges.

name: Hoisin Duck Pancakes
description: Chinese-style shredded duck with hoisin in fluffy pancakes
instructions: Pan-fry duck skin-side down 8 mins until crispy.
Flip, cook 5 more mins. Rest 5 mins then shred.
Warm pancakes in a steamer or wrapped in damp paper towel in microwave.
Julienne cucumber and spring onions.
Spread hoisin on pancake, top with duck, cucumber and spring onions.
Roll and enjoy.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Pasta
description: Creamy ricotta pasta with baby spinach — vegetarian and fast
instructions: Cook pasta per packet, reserve 1 cup pasta water.
While pasta cooks, sauté garlic in oil 1 min.
Add spinach, cook until just wilted.
Mix ricotta with lemon juice, zest and half the parmesan.
Toss hot pasta with ricotta mix, spinach and pasta water to loosen.
Plate, top with remaining parmesan and chilli flakes.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Enchiladas
description: Vegetarian enchiladas packed with flavour and colour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Dice and roast sweet potato with cumin and paprika 20 mins.
Mix roasted sweet potato with drained black beans.
Spoon filling into tortillas, roll and place seam-side down in baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over, top with cheese.
Bake 15 mins until bubbling.
Serve with sour cream and coriander.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
description: The classic Caesar salad with grilled chicken breast
instructions: Season chicken and cook in a pan 5-6 mins each side, rest and slice.
Tear bread into croutons, toss in oil and toast in same pan.
Fry bacon until crispy.
Chop lettuce, toss with Caesar dressing.
Top with chicken, croutons, bacon and parmesan.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Pork Dumplings
description: Steamed pork dumplings with chilli dipping sauce — family favourite
instructions: Finely chop cabbage, sprinkle with salt, squeeze out moisture.
Mix pork, cabbage, spring onions, ginger, 2 tbsp soy and sesame oil.
Place 1 tsp filling in centre of each wrapper, fold and pleat to seal.
Steam dumplings in batches 10-12 mins, or pan-fry 3 mins then steam.
Mix remaining soy, vinegar and chilli oil for dipping sauce.
Serve dumplings with dipping sauce.

name: Lemon Herb Barramundi
description: Pan-fried Australian barramundi with lemon butter and greens
instructions: Boil potatoes 12 mins until tender, drain and halve.
Steam broccolini until tender-crisp.
Pan-fry barramundi skin-side down 4 mins until crispy, flip 2 mins.
Remove fish, add butter, garlic and capers to pan.
Squeeze in lemon, swirl until foamy.
Plate fish over potatoes and greens, pour lemon butter sauce over.
Garnish with parsley.

name: Caramelised Onion & Cheddar Frittata
description: Slow-cooked onions with sharp cheddar in a baked egg frittata
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Slice onions thinly.
Melt butter in oven-safe pan, cook onions over low heat 15 mins until golden.
Add balsamic and thyme, cook 2 more mins.
Whisk eggs with milk, season well.
Pour over onions, top with cheddar.
Bake 12-15 mins until set. Serve with salad.

name: Crispy Beef Tacos
description: Spiced beef mince in crispy shells with fresh toppings
instructions: Brown the beef mince in a pan over high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add taco seasoning and a splash of water, stir and simmer 3 mins.
Warm taco shells in the oven at 180°C for 3 mins.
Shred lettuce and dice tomatoes.
Fill shells with mince, top with lettuce, tomato, cheese and sour cream.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
description: Sticky honey garlic glazed chicken thighs — a crowd-pleaser
instructions: Mince garlic. Mix honey, soy, vinegar and garlic in a bowl.
Heat oil in a large pan, sear chicken thighs 4 mins each side until golden.
Pour sauce over the chicken and reduce heat to medium.
Simmer 8 mins, turning the chicken halfway, until sauce is thick and sticky.
Serve over steamed rice with pan sauce spooned over.

name: Tomato Basil Pasta
description: Fresh tomato and basil pasta with garlic — simple and vibrant
instructions: Boil a large pot of salted water, cook pasta until al dente.
Halve cherry tomatoes. Slice garlic thinly.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté garlic until golden — about 1 min.
Add tomatoes and cook 5 mins until they burst and release juice.
Drain pasta, reserving ½ cup pasta water. Add pasta to the tomato pan.
Toss with basil, parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Serve immediately.

name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Quick, satisfying fried rice with egg and vegetables
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan over very high heat.
Add frozen veg and stir-fry 2 mins until thawed.
Push veg to the side, scramble eggs in the centre, then mix through.
Add cold rice and break up any clumps — press rice against hot pan.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss everything well.
Top with sliced spring onions and serve hot.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
description: Crispy cheese and chicken quesadillas — quick and filling
instructions: Shred cooked chicken. Dice capsicum and slice spring onions.
Lay a tortilla flat, sprinkle half with cheese, chicken, capsicum and onion.
Fold tortilla in half. Heat a dry pan over medium heat.
Cook quesadilla 2-3 mins each side until golden and cheese is melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream.

name: Beef Burrito Bowl
description: Mexican-spiced beef over rice with fresh salsa and sour cream
instructions: Cook rice. Brown beef mince in a pan over high heat.
Add taco seasoning and drained black beans, cook 3 mins.
Halve tomatoes. Dice avocado and squeeze lime juice over to prevent browning.
Assemble bowls: rice base, spiced beef and beans, fresh tomato, avocado.
Top with sour cream and a squeeze of lime. Serve immediately.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: Fragrant green curry with chicken and vegetables
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Slice zucchini.
Heat a splash of coconut milk in a pan, fry curry paste 2 mins until fragrant.
Add chicken and stir to coat, cook 3 mins.
Pour in remaining coconut milk, add zucchini. Simmer 12 mins.
Stir in spinach and fish sauce. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve over jasmine rice with a squeeze of lime.

name: Sausage and Vegetable Tray Bake
description: Effortless one-tray bake with pork sausages and roasted vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Halve potatoes, chop capsicum, zucchini and onion.
Place vegetables in a large roasting tray. Drizzle with oil, season well.
Nestle sausages among vegetables. Sprinkle with mixed herbs.
Roast 30-35 mins, turning halfway, until sausages are golden and veg tender.
Serve directly from the tray.

name: Pasta Arrabbiata
description: Spicy tomato pasta with chilli and garlic — quick and bold
instructions: Boil salted water, cook pasta until al dente.
Slice garlic thinly. Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and chilli flakes, cook 1 min until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, season, simmer 10 mins.
Drain pasta, toss with sauce. Serve with parmesan if desired.

name: Lamb Kofta with Hummus
description: Spiced lamb mince koftas served with hummus and flatbread
instructions: Mince garlic. Mix lamb, garlic, cumin, coriander and paprika well.
Shape into 12 small oval patties or sausage shapes.
Heat a lightly oiled pan or grill to medium-high.
Cook koftas 3-4 mins each side until cooked through.
Slice cucumber. Warm flatbreads in a dry pan.
Serve koftas on flatbread with hummus and cucumber.

name: Honey Soy Salmon
description: Quick glazed salmon fillets with a sweet soy marinade
instructions: Mince garlic. Whisk together honey, soy, sesame oil and garlic.
Pat salmon dry. Pour half the marinade over the fish, rest 5 mins.
Heat a pan over medium-high, cook salmon skin-side down 4 mins.
Flip, pour remaining marinade over. Cook 2-3 mins until just cooked through.
Steam broccolini. Serve salmon with broccolini and pan glaze spooned over.

name: Prawn Aglio e Olio
description: Prawns with garlic, chilli and olive oil pasta — ready in 15 mins
instructions: Boil salted water and cook spaghetti until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Thinly slice garlic. Chop parsley.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium, add garlic and chilli. Cook 90 secs until golden.
Add prawns, cook 2 mins each side until pink.
Drain pasta, add to pan with a splash of pasta water, toss to coat.
Finish with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
description: Smoky roasted sweet potato and black bean vegetarian tacos
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Dice sweet potato into 2cm cubes.
Toss with oil, cumin, paprika and salt. Roast 20-25 mins until tender.
Drain and rinse black beans, warm in a pan with a pinch of cumin.
Mash avocado with lime juice and salt.
Warm tortillas. Fill with sweet potato, black beans and avocado.
Finish with a squeeze of lime and any extra toppings.

name: Satay Noodles
description: Quick peanut satay noodles with chicken and Asian vegetables
instructions: Slice chicken thinly. Mix peanut butter, soy, coconut milk and sweet chilli into a sauce.
Cook noodles per packet instructions, drain and set aside.
Stir-fry chicken in a hot oiled wok 3-4 mins until cooked.
Add frozen veg and stir-fry 2 mins.
Add noodles and satay sauce, toss to coat everything well.
Serve hot, garnished with crushed peanuts if desired.

name: Lemon Herb Pork Cutlets
description: Pan-fried pork cutlets with a bright lemon and herb crust
instructions: Mince garlic, zest and juice one lemon. Mix with olive oil and rosemary.
Marinate pork cutlets in the mixture for 10 mins.
Boil baby potatoes until just tender, then halve and pan-fry until golden.
Heat a pan, sear pork cutlets 4 mins each side until cooked through.
Rest pork 3 mins. Steam or boil green beans.
Serve pork with potatoes, beans and a slice of lemon.

name: Chicken Pad See Ew
description: Smoky Thai-style flat noodles with chicken and broccolini
instructions: Soak noodles in hot water 8 mins until softened. Drain well.
Slice chicken and chop broccolini. Mince garlic.
Heat a wok over very high heat, stir-fry chicken until cooked. Set aside.
Add garlic, broccolini and crack in eggs — scramble quickly.
Add drained noodles, dark soy and oyster sauce. Toss vigorously.
Return chicken, toss to combine and serve immediately.

name: Corn Fritters
description: Crispy sweetcorn fritters — great with sour cream and avocado
instructions: Drain corn. Slice spring onions. Grate cheese.
Mix corn, flour, eggs, spring onion and cheese until combined.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Drop heaped spoonfuls of batter into the pan, flatten slightly.
Cook 2-3 mins each side until golden brown.
Serve with sour cream and sliced avocado.

name: Baked Lemon Chicken
description: Juicy oven-baked lemon chicken thighs — minimal prep, great flavour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Halve potatoes and spread in a roasting tray.
Mince garlic. Mix with lemon zest, lemon juice, olive oil and oregano.
Place chicken thighs over the potatoes. Pour marinade over everything.
Season well with salt and pepper.
Bake 30-35 mins until chicken is golden and potatoes are tender.
Rest 5 mins before serving with pan juices.

name: Tuna and Vegetable Pasta Bake
description: Budget pasta bake with tuna and vegetables in a creamy sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Cook pasta until al dente, drain.
Dice onion and cook in a pan until soft.
Mix soup, milk, drained tuna, onion, peas and pasta together.
Pour into a baking dish. Top with grated cheddar.
Bake 20-25 mins until bubbling and golden on top.
Rest 5 mins before serving.

name: Lamb Rogan Josh
description: Rich, warming lamb curry with aromatic spices — slow-cooked flavour
instructions: Dice onion. Mince garlic and grate ginger.
Brown lamb pieces in batches in a hot oiled pan. Set aside.
Sauté onion until golden, add garlic and ginger, cook 2 mins.
Add spice paste, stir 1 min. Add tomatoes and 150ml water.
Return lamb, bring to a simmer, cover and cook 35 mins.
Stir in yoghurt off the heat. Serve with steamed rice.

name: Fish and Chips
description: Crispy battered fish with oven-baked chips — an Aussie favourite
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into chips, toss with olive oil and salt.
Roast chips 30 mins, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.
Whisk flour with beer or sparkling water until a thick batter forms.
Heat frying oil in a deep pan to 180°C.
Dip fish in batter, fry in batches 3-4 mins until golden and cooked through.
Drain on paper towel. Serve with chips and lemon wedges.

name: Teriyaki Beef Stir-Fry
description: Glossy teriyaki beef strips with broccoli over steamed rice
instructions: Thinly slice beef against the grain. Mix soy, mirin and honey into a sauce.
Cut broccoli into florets. Blanch 2 mins in boiling water, drain.
Heat a wok over very high heat. Stir-fry beef in batches until just cooked.
Add garlic and broccoli, stir-fry 1 min.
Pour in teriyaki sauce, toss to coat and reduce 1 min until glossy.
Serve over rice, topped with sesame seeds.

name: Veggie Dahl
description: Warming red lentil dahl with spinach and coconut — budget gold
instructions: Dice onion, mince garlic. Rinse red lentils well.
Sauté onion in a pot until golden, add garlic and curry powder, cook 1 min.
Add lentils, tomatoes and coconut milk. Bring to a simmer.
Cook 20-25 mins, stirring occasionally, until lentils are completely soft.
Stir in baby spinach until just wilted. Season well.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Chicken and Leek Soup
description: Hearty homestyle chicken and leek soup with vegetables
instructions: Slice leeks, dice carrots and celery. Mince garlic.
Sauté leeks in a pot with a little oil until soft, about 5 mins.
Add garlic, carrots, celery and thyme. Cook 3 mins.
Add whole chicken breast and stock. Bring to a simmer.
Cook 20 mins until chicken is cooked through. Remove and shred chicken.
Return shredded chicken to the pot. Season and serve with bread.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
description: Pasta tubes filled with spinach and ricotta, baked in tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Mix ricotta, spinach, egg and half the parmesan. Season well.
Mince garlic, stir into passata with salt and a pinch of sugar.
Spoon or pipe ricotta filling into cannelloni tubes.
Spread a third of the sauce in a baking dish. Lay filled tubes on top.
Pour remaining sauce over, top with mozzarella and remaining parmesan.
Cover with foil, bake 30 mins. Remove foil and bake 10 more mins until golden.

name: Spicy Chickpea and Tomato Stew
description: Smoky, warming chickpea stew with crusty bread — vegan and cheap
instructions: Dice onion, mince garlic. Drain and rinse chickpeas.
Sauté onion in olive oil until golden, about 5 mins.
Add garlic, paprika and cumin, cook 1 min until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas, season well. Simmer 12 mins.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve with crusty bread for dipping.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Rich, creamy tomato-based Indian chicken curry
instructions: Dice chicken and onion. Mince garlic.
Sauté onion in oil until golden, add garlic and tikka paste, cook 2 mins.
Add chicken, seal 5 mins, turning often.
Stir in tomatoes, simmer 15 mins until chicken is tender.
Stir in cream and heat through. Adjust seasoning.
Serve over rice topped with coriander.

name: Creamy Chicken Pasta
description: Tender chicken in a rich cream sauce with spinach and parmesan
instructions: Cook pasta per packet. Drain and set aside.
Slice chicken into thin strips. Season well.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add chicken and cook until golden.
Add stock and cream, simmer 5 mins.
Stir in spinach until wilted, add parmesan.
Toss through pasta and serve immediately.

name: Whole Roast Chicken Traybake
description: Juicy whole roast chicken with golden potatoes and vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cut vegetables into chunks, place in a large roasting tray.
Stuff chicken cavity with halved lemon, rosemary and garlic. Truss legs.
Rub chicken with oil and season generously. Place on top of vegetables.
Roast 1 hour 10 mins, basting twice, until juices run clear.
Rest chicken 10 mins before carving. Serve with roasted vegetables.

name: BBQ Chicken Pizza
description: Quick pizzas topped with BBQ sauce, chicken and melted cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C. Slice and cook chicken in a pan until cooked through, shred.
Spread BBQ sauce over pizza bases.
Top with chicken, sliced red onion and capsicum.
Scatter over both cheeses.
Bake 10–12 mins until bases are crispy and cheese is golden. Top with spring onion.

name: Chicken and Corn Chowder
description: Thick and creamy chicken soup with sweet corn — great for winter
instructions: Dice potato and onion. Cube chicken.
Melt butter, sauté onion until soft. Add garlic and cook 1 min.
Add potato, chicken and stock. Bring to a simmer, cook 15 mins.
Remove chicken, shred roughly, return to pot.
Stir in corn and cream, cook 5 mins. Season well and serve.

name: Moroccan Spiced Chicken Bowl
description: Aromatic Moroccan chicken over couscous with chickpeas and herbs
instructions: Coat chicken thighs with ras el hanout and a little oil. Season.
Sear chicken in batches until golden. Set aside.
Sauté onion, add tomatoes and chickpeas. Return chicken, simmer 25 mins.
Prepare couscous per packet, fluff with a fork.
Serve chicken and sauce over couscous with coriander and lemon wedges.

name: Chicken Gyros with Tzatziki
description: Greek-style marinated chicken wraps with fresh salad and tzatziki
instructions: Mix oil, oregano and garlic, coat chicken. Marinate 15 mins or overnight.
Grill or pan-fry chicken 5–6 mins per side until cooked. Rest and slice.
Warm flatbreads. Slice tomatoes, shred lettuce, thinly slice onion.
Spread tzatziki on flatbreads. Layer salad then chicken.
Roll up and serve immediately.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Classic Sichuan-inspired spicy chicken with peanuts and dried chilli
instructions: Cube chicken, toss with cornflour. Mince garlic, chop spring onion.
Mix soy, hoisin and 1 tbsp water into a sauce.
Stir-fry chillies in a hot wok until fragrant. Add chicken in batches, cook until golden.
Add garlic and spring onion, stir-fry 1 min.
Pour in sauce, add peanuts, toss to coat. Serve over rice.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Quick egg-fried rice with tender chicken and vegetables
instructions: Dice chicken and carrot. Beat eggs. Mince garlic.
Stir-fry chicken in a hot wok until cooked. Set aside.
Add carrot, peas and garlic, cook 2 mins. Push to side, scramble eggs.
Add cold rice, break up any clumps. Return chicken.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss everything together. Serve topped with spring onion.

name: Chicken and Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy risotto with chicken, earthy mushrooms and parmesan
instructions: Warm stock. Dice onion, slice mushrooms, cube chicken.
Sauté onion in butter until soft. Add garlic and mushrooms, cook 5 mins. Set mushrooms aside.
Add chicken, cook until sealed. Add rice, stir 1 min.
Pour in wine, stir until absorbed. Add stock one ladle at a time, stirring constantly 20–25 mins.
Stir in mushrooms, butter and parmesan. Season and serve.

name: Chicken Burgers with Aioli
description: Juicy pan-fried chicken burgers with creamy aioli and fresh salad
instructions: Halve chicken breasts and pound to even thickness. Season well.
Cook chicken 4–5 mins per side in a hot pan until golden and cooked through.
Toast brioche buns. Slice tomato, cucumber and onion.
Spread aioli on buns. Layer lettuce, tomato, cucumber and onion.
Top with chicken and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chicken Laksa
description: Fragrant coconut noodle soup with tender chicken and bean sprouts
instructions: Slice chicken into strips. Soak noodles per packet.
Fry laksa paste in a pot 2 mins until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and stock, bring to a simmer.
Add chicken, cook 12 mins until tender.
Divide noodles into bowls, ladle over broth. Top with bean sprouts, spring onion and lime.

name: Chicken and Sweet Potato Tray Bake
description: One-tray chicken dinner with sweet potato, broccoli and Asian glaze
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cube sweet potato, cut broccoli into florets.
Mix soy, honey, garlic powder, paprika and oil into a glaze.
Toss sweet potato and chicken with half the glaze. Spread on a large baking tray.
Roast 25 mins. Add broccoli, brush everything with remaining glaze.
Roast 15 more mins until chicken is cooked and vegetables are caramelised.

name: Poached Chicken Sesame Noodles
description: Silky poached chicken sliced over cold sesame noodles — quick and healthy
instructions: Poach chicken in simmering salted water 15 mins. Cool in cooking liquid, slice thinly.
Cook noodles per packet. Rinse under cold water, drain.
Whisk soy sauce, sesame oil and ginger together.
Toss noodles with dressing. Shred cucumber into ribbons.
Serve noodles topped with chicken, cucumber, spring onion and sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
description: Italian hunter's chicken braised in tomatoes, olives and herbs
instructions: Season chicken pieces. Brown in batches in olive oil. Set aside.
Sauté onion until soft, add garlic and cook 1 min.
Add wine, scraping up any bits. Add tomatoes, olives, capers and thyme.
Return chicken, bring to a simmer. Cover and cook 35 mins until tender.
Adjust seasoning. Serve with crusty bread or polenta.

name: Grilled Chicken Chimichurri Bowl
description: Smoky grilled chicken over rice with bright herby chimichurri
instructions: Blitz parsley, garlic, olive oil, vinegar and chilli to make chimichurri. Season.
Season chicken, grill or pan-fry 5–6 mins per side until cooked. Rest and slice.
Grill capsicum until charred. Slice.
Serve rice in bowls topped with capsicum, chicken and a generous spoonful of chimichurri.

name: Chicken Congee
description: Silky Chinese rice porridge with ginger-poached chicken and toppings
instructions: Combine rice and stock in a large pot. Add whole chicken thighs and sliced ginger.
Bring to a boil, reduce to a gentle simmer. Cook 30–35 mins, stirring occasionally.
Remove chicken, shred roughly.
Return chicken to pot. Season with soy sauce, sesame oil and white pepper.
Serve in bowls topped with sliced spring onion.

name: Spicy Chicken Naan Wraps
description: Fragrant spiced chicken strips in warm naan with cooling yoghurt
instructions: Mix garam masala, cayenne and a little oil. Coat chicken strips.
Cook chicken in a hot pan 8–10 mins until cooked and slightly charred.
Warm naan. Slice cucumber and tomato.
Spread yoghurt on naan, layer with salad and spiced chicken.
Top with coriander and wrap up.

name: Thai Basil Chicken
description: Fast wok-fried chicken mince with thai basil and a fried egg on top
instructions: Mince garlic, chop chilli. Fry eggs sunny-side up in a little oil and set aside.
Heat wok on high. Stir-fry garlic and chilli 30 secs.
Add chicken mince, break up, cook until no longer pink.
Add fish sauce and oyster sauce, stir 1 min. Remove from heat, stir in basil.
Serve over rice topped with a fried egg.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
description: Wholesome chicken broth with vegetables — the ultimate comfort food
instructions: Dice vegetables. Mince garlic.
Bring stock to a boil. Add whole chicken breast, simmer 20 mins.
Remove chicken, shred. Return to pot.
Add carrots, celery, zucchini, corn, garlic and thyme. Simmer 12 mins.
Season well and serve.

name: Chicken Parmigiana
description: Classic crumbed chicken topped with passata and melted cheese
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to even 1.5cm thickness. Season.
Set up three bowls: flour, beaten egg, breadcrumbs. Coat chicken in order.
Pan-fry crumbed chicken 3–4 mins per side until golden. Transfer to baking tray.
Top each schnitzel with passata and cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 15 mins until cheese is melted and golden. Serve with salad.

name: Chicken Satay Skewers
description: Grilled chicken skewers with a rich peanut dipping sauce
instructions: Cube chicken, thread onto skewers. Season.
Mix peanut butter, coconut milk, soy and lime juice with a little garlic into a sauce.
Brush chicken with some sauce, grill or barbecue 8–10 mins, turning often.
Serve with remaining peanut sauce as a dip, rice and sliced cucumber.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
description: Sticky teriyaki-glazed chicken thighs over fluffy steamed rice
instructions: Mix soy, mirin and honey into a teriyaki sauce.
Steam broccoli 3 mins. Cook rice.
Sear chicken thighs skin-side down in a pan until golden. Flip and cook through.
Pour teriyaki sauce into the pan, bubble and toss to coat.
Serve over rice with broccoli, spring onion and sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Souvlaki Wraps
description: Greek marinated chicken in warm flatbread with tzatziki and salad
instructions: Mix oregano, olive oil and lemon juice. Coat chicken and marinate 15 mins.
Grill or pan-fry chicken 5–6 mins each side until cooked through. Rest and slice.
Warm flatbreads on a dry pan.
Layer tzatziki, lettuce, tomato and onion on each wrap. Top with chicken.
Squeeze over lemon and roll up to serve.

name: Creamy Coconut Chicken Curry
description: Thai-inspired chicken curry in silky coconut milk with red curry paste
instructions: Cook rice per packet. Cube chicken thighs.
Fry curry paste in a pan 2 mins until fragrant.
Add chicken, seal on all sides.
Pour in coconut milk and bamboo shoots. Simmer 15 mins.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice. Serve over rice with coriander.

name: Chicken Chow Mein
description: Cantonese-style stir-fried noodles with chicken and crispy cabbage
instructions: Slice chicken thinly. Shred cabbage, slice carrot and garlic.
Stir-fry chicken in a hot wok until golden. Set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables 3 mins until just tender.
Add noodles and sauces, toss to coat. Return chicken.
Stir-fry 2 mins until everything is combined. Serve topped with spring onion.

name: Chicken and Bacon Pasta
description: Creamy pasta with crispy bacon and tender chicken — a family favourite
instructions: Cook pasta per packet. Dice chicken, chop bacon.
Cook bacon until crispy, set aside. Sauté garlic in same pan.
Add chicken, cook through. Add cream and peas, simmer 3 mins.
Drain pasta, add to pan. Toss with parmesan.
Top with crispy bacon and serve immediately.

name: Mango Chicken Stir-fry
description: Sweet and savoury stir-fry with juicy mango and colourful capsicum
instructions: Slice chicken into strips. Dice mango and capsicum.
Stir-fry chicken in a hot wok until golden. Set aside.
Stir-fry garlic and capsicum 2 mins.
Return chicken, add mango, soy and sweet chilli. Toss 1 min.
Serve over rice with spring onion.

name: Chicken Katsu Curry
description: Crispy panko-crumbed chicken with Japanese curry sauce over rice
instructions: Pound chicken to 1.5cm thick. Coat in flour, egg then panko.
Shallow-fry chicken 4 mins per side until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towel.
Heat curry sauce per packet instructions.
Finely shred cabbage.
Serve rice in bowls, slice chicken and lay on top. Pour over curry sauce, add a mound of cabbage.

name: Lemon Pepper Chicken with Chips
description: Zesty grilled chicken with crispy oven-baked chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into chips, toss with oil and rosemary. Roast 30 mins.
Mix lemon zest, juice, pepper and garlic powder. Coat chicken.
Grill or pan-fry chicken 6–7 mins per side until cooked through and golden.
Rest chicken 5 mins. Serve with chips and salad.

name: Smoked Paprika Chicken Drumsticks
description: Tender baked drumsticks with a smoky spice rub and potato wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Mix paprika, garlic powder, cumin and oil.
Coat drumsticks in spice mix. Place on a lined baking tray with potato wedges.
Roast 40–45 mins until drumsticks are cooked through and skin is crispy.
Squeeze lemon over chicken. Serve with salad.

name: Chicken and Spinach Curry
description: Quick mid-week curry with chicken, spinach and warming spices
instructions: Dice onion, mince garlic and grate ginger. Cube chicken.
Sauté onion until golden. Add garlic, ginger and garam masala, cook 2 mins.
Add chicken, seal all sides.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk, simmer 20 mins until chicken is cooked.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Serve over rice.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
description: Smoky, hearty Mexican soup loaded with chicken, beans and corn
instructions: Simmer chicken breast in stock 15 mins until cooked. Remove and shred.
Add cumin, chilli, tomatoes, beans and corn to the stock. Simmer 10 mins.
Return shredded chicken. Season well.
Ladle into bowls. Top with sour cream and corn chips.

name: Honey Chilli Chicken
description: Sticky sweet-heat chicken thighs perfect for midweek dinner
instructions: Mix honey, sriracha, soy sauce and garlic into a glaze.
Toss chicken thighs with cornflour. Season.
Pan-fry chicken skin-side down until crispy. Flip and cook through.
Pour glaze into pan, toss to coat and reduce 2 mins until sticky.
Serve over rice, topped with sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Piccata
description: Thin chicken cutlets in a bright lemon-caper butter sauce
instructions: Cook linguine. Pound chicken thin. Dust in flour, season.
Pan-fry chicken in oil 3 mins per side until golden. Set aside.
Add wine to pan, deglaze. Add stock and lemon juice, simmer 3 mins.
Swirl in butter and capers.
Return chicken to sauce. Serve over linguine with parsley.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-fry
description: Tender beef strips with broccoli in a rich oyster sauce
instructions: Thinly slice beef, toss with cornflour and soy sauce.
Cut broccoli into florets. Blanch 2 mins, drain.
Stir-fry beef in batches over very high heat until browned. Set aside.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger 30 secs. Add broccoli and oyster sauce.
Return beef, toss to coat. Serve over rice.

name: Beef Kofta Kebabs
description: Spiced beef mince skewers with Greek salad and flatbread
instructions: Mix mince with grated onion, garlic, parsley, cumin and paprika. Season.
Shape mixture around skewers into long ovals.
Grill or pan-fry koftas 3–4 mins per side until cooked through.
Make a simple salad with tomato, cucumber and feta.
Serve koftas with flatbread and salad.

name: Classic Beef Burgers
description: Juicy beef patties with all the classic toppings
instructions: Mix mince with salt and pepper. Shape into 4 even patties.
Cook patties in a hot pan or grill 4 mins per side for medium.
Place cheese on patties in last minute, cover to melt.
Toast buns. Build burgers with ketchup, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.
Serve immediately.

name: Beef and Mushroom Pie
description: Rich beef and mushroom filling in buttery shortcrust pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Brown beef in batches, set aside.
Sauté onion and mushrooms until golden. Add wine and deglaze.
Add beef, stock, Worcestershire and thyme. Simmer 40 mins.
Mix cornflour with water, stir in to thicken. Cool filling slightly.
Line a pie dish with pastry, fill, top with second sheet. Bake 30 mins until golden.

name: Cottage Pie
description: Classic British shepherd's-style pie with beef mince and cheesy mash top
instructions: Brown mince with diced onion and carrot. Drain fat.
Stir in tomato paste, stock and Worcestershire. Simmer 15 mins. Add peas.
Boil potatoes until soft. Mash with butter and half the cheddar.
Spoon mince into a baking dish, top with mash and remaining cheddar.
Bake 25 mins at 190°C until golden on top.

name: Beef Massaman Curry
description: Rich, slow-cooked Thai curry with tender beef and potato
instructions: Brown beef cubes in batches. Set aside.
Fry curry paste in pot 2 mins.
Add coconut milk, beef, potatoes and peanuts. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook 60–70 mins until beef is very tender.
Season with fish sauce and lime. Serve over rice.

name: Beef Meatloaf
description: Comfort-food meatloaf glazed with ketchup and served with mash
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Finely dice onion, mince garlic.
Mix mince, breadcrumbs, eggs, onion, garlic, Worcestershire and half the ketchup. Season.
Shape into a loaf on a lined tray. Spread remaining ketchup on top.
Bake 50–55 mins until cooked through and glazed.
Rest 10 mins before slicing. Serve with mashed potato.

name: Beef and Lentil Soup
description: Warming, hearty soup with beef and red lentils — great batch cook
instructions: Dice beef, vegetables and onion.
Brown beef in a pot. Set aside.
Sauté onion, carrot, celery 5 mins. Add cumin and paprika.
Add lentils, tomatoes, stock and beef. Bring to a simmer, cook 30 mins.
Season well. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
description: Fall-apart beef with winter vegetables in a rich red wine broth
instructions: Season and brown beef in batches. Transfer to slow cooker.
Add vegetables, stock, wine, tomato paste and thyme.
Cook on low 7–8 hrs or high 4 hrs.
Mix cornflour with water, stir into stew to thicken.
Serve with crusty bread or mashed potato.

name: Beef Fajitas
description: Sizzling beef strips with capsicum, onion and all the trimmings
instructions: Slice capsicum and onion into strips. Toss beef with fajita seasoning.
Stir-fry beef in a very hot pan until slightly charred. Set aside.
Cook capsicum and onion in same pan until softened and charred.
Warm tortillas. Assemble with beef, capsicum mix, sour cream and cheese.
Squeeze lime over and serve.

name: Beef Lasagna
description: Classic layered lasagna with beef bolognese and béchamel
instructions: Brown mince with onion and garlic. Add tomatoes and passata, simmer 20 mins.
Preheat oven to 180°C. Mix ricotta with one egg.
Layer: meat sauce, pasta sheets, ricotta, repeat. Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil, bake 30 mins. Remove foil, bake 15 more mins until golden.
Rest 10 mins before cutting.

name: Smash Burgers
description: Ultra-crispy double smash patties with melted cheese
instructions: Divide mince into 8 balls, season. Slice onion and tomato.
Heat a flat pan or griddle until very hot.
Smash each ball flat with a spatula, cook 2 mins. Flip and add cheese, cook 1 min.
Stack two patties per bun.
Build burgers with sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.

name: Beef Goulash
description: Hungarian beef and paprika stew over egg noodles
instructions: Brown beef cubes in batches. Set aside.
Sauté onion, capsicum and garlic until soft.
Add paprika and tomato paste, cook 1 min.
Add beef and stock. Simmer 35–40 mins until tender.
Cook noodles. Serve goulash over noodles with a dollop of sour cream.

name: Beef and Black Bean Stir-fry
description: Quick Asian-style stir-fry with punchy black bean sauce
instructions: Slice beef and capsicum.
Stir-fry beef in batches over very high heat until seared. Set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger and capsicum 2 mins.
Add black beans, oyster sauce and soy. Return beef, toss 1 min.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Mexican Beef Rice Bowl
description: Spiced beef mince over rice with all the classic Mexican toppings
instructions: Brown mince with cumin and chilli powder. Season.
Warm beans and corn. Cook rice.
Divide rice into bowls. Top with mince, beans, corn and salsa.
Add avocado, sour cream and cheddar.
Serve immediately.

name: Beef Stroganoff
description: Classic creamy Russian beef dish with mushrooms over egg noodles
instructions: Sear beef strips in batches over very high heat. Set aside.
Cook noodles per packet.
Sauté onion and garlic in butter until soft. Add mushrooms, cook 5 mins.
Add stock and mustard. Simmer 3 mins. Stir in sour cream.
Return beef to sauce. Serve over egg noodles.

name: Meatball Spaghetti
description: Tender beef meatballs in rich tomato passata over spaghetti
instructions: Mix mince, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic and oregano. Roll into 20 meatballs.
Brown meatballs in oil 5 mins, turning. Set aside.
Add passata to pan, simmer. Return meatballs, cover 20 mins.
Cook spaghetti per packet.
Serve meatballs and sauce over pasta with parmesan.

name: Beef and Kimchi Fried Rice
description: Bold Korean-inspired fried rice with spicy kimchi and beef
instructions: Brown beef mince in a wok. Set aside.
Stir-fry kimchi 2 mins. Push to side, scramble eggs.
Add rice and mince, break up any clumps.
Add soy, sesame oil and gochujang. Toss everything together.
Serve topped with spring onion.

name: BBQ Beef Brisket
description: Slow-cooked smoky beef brisket with coleslaw on brioche
instructions: Mix paprika, sugar, salt and pepper. Rub over brisket.
Sear brisket all sides in a heavy pot. Remove.
Add onion and garlic, cook 2 mins. Return brisket, add BBQ sauce and 200ml water.
Cover, cook 3–4 hrs at 160°C until fork-tender.
Shred brisket, serve on rolls with coleslaw and extra BBQ sauce.

name: Beef Pho
description: Vietnamese rice noodle soup with thinly sliced beef and aromatics
instructions: Warm stock with star anise and ginger. Simmer 20 mins, strain.
Soak noodles per packet. Season broth with fish sauce.
Slice beef paper-thin against the grain.
Divide noodles into bowls. Pour hot broth over. Lay raw beef on top — broth will cook it.
Serve with bean sprouts, spring onion and lime wedges.

name: Beef and Potato Curry
description: Hearty curry with tender beef and potatoes in spiced sauce
instructions: Cube beef and potato. Dice onion, mince garlic and grate ginger.
Brown beef in batches. Set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and curry powder 3 mins.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk, beef and potato. Simmer 35 mins.
Serve over rice with coriander.

name: Korean Beef Mince Bowl
description: Quick Korean ground beef over steamed rice with pickled cucumber
instructions: Mince garlic, grate ginger.
Brown mince over high heat, breaking up lumps.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 min.
Stir in soy, sesame oil and sugar. Cook 2 mins until glazed.
Serve over rice with spring onion and sesame seeds.

name: Beef Kofta with Tahini Sauce
description: Middle Eastern spiced beef mince skewers with lemon tahini
instructions: Mix mince with 2 garlic cloves, cumin, parsley and seasoning. Shape onto skewers.
Grill koftas 4 mins per side.
Mix tahini with remaining garlic, lemon juice and enough water to drizzle.
Warm flatbread. Slice tomatoes and onion.
Serve koftas on flatbread with tahini drizzle and salad.

name: Slow-Roasted Beef Short Ribs
description: Meltingly tender short ribs braised in red wine and served with mash
instructions: Season and brown ribs all over in a heavy pot. Set aside.
Sauté onion and carrot 5 mins. Add garlic and tomato paste.
Add wine, stock and thyme. Return ribs, bring to a simmer.
Cover tightly, roast at 150°C for 3 hrs until meat falls off bone.
Skim fat from sauce. Serve ribs over mash with sauce and carrots.

name: Cheeseburger Pasta Bake
description: All the flavours of a cheeseburger in a cosy pasta bake
instructions: Cook pasta al dente. Brown mince with onion and garlic.
Add tomato paste, tomatoes and mustard. Season.
Combine pasta and mince sauce in a baking dish.
Top with cheddar.
Bake 20 mins at 190°C until cheese is golden and bubbling. Serve with pickles.

name: Pork and Noodle Stir-fry
description: Savoury pork mince with bok choy and hokkien noodles
instructions: Separate bok choy leaves. Mince garlic and grate ginger.
Brown pork mince over high heat 5 mins. Add garlic and ginger.
Add bok choy, cook until wilted.
Add noodles, soy and hoisin. Toss to combine over heat 2 mins.
Serve topped with spring onion.

name: Honey Glazed Pork Tenderloin
description: Juicy pork tenderloin with a sticky honey soy glaze and vegetables
instructions: Mix honey, soy, mustard and garlic into a marinade. Coat pork.
Sear pork in an oven-safe pan, all sides, until golden.
Add remaining marinade, roast at 200°C for 15–18 mins until cooked through.
Rest 5 mins, slice.
Serve with mash and steamed beans.

name: Pork Fried Rice
description: Quick pork fried rice with vegetables and egg
instructions: Dice carrot. Beat eggs.
Brown pork mince over high heat. Set aside.
Stir-fry carrot, peas and garlic 2 mins. Push to side, scramble eggs.
Add rice and mince, toss together.
Season with soy and sesame oil. Serve with spring onion.

name: Pasta Carbonara
description: Authentic carbonara with silky egg and parmesan sauce — no cream
instructions: Cook spaghetti al dente — reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Whisk eggs with parmesan and pepper.
Fry bacon with garlic until crispy.
Remove pan from heat. Add drained pasta and egg mix, tossing rapidly.
Add pasta water a little at a time to reach a creamy consistency. Serve immediately.

name: Pork Sausages with Apple Mash
description: Rustic bangers and mash with sweet apple and caramelised onion gravy
instructions: Boil potatoes 20 mins until soft.
Cook sausages in a pan 15 mins, turning often, until cooked through.
Core and slice apples, add to the pan for last 5 mins to soften.
Drain potatoes, mash with butter and milk. Season.
Warm gravy. Serve sausages on mash with apples and gravy.

name: Ham and Cheese Quesadillas
description: Crispy golden quesadillas stuffed with ham and melted cheddar
instructions: Dice ham and capsicum, grate cheddar.
Layer one tortilla with ham, capsicum and cheese. Top with another tortilla.
Cook in a dry pan 2–3 mins per side until golden and cheese is melted.
Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Cut into wedges, serve with sour cream, avocado and salsa.

name: Pork Banh Mi Bowl
description: Vietnamese-inspired pork mince bowl with pickled vegetables and rice
instructions: Cook rice. Julienne carrot and slice cucumber.
Brown pork mince with garlic. Season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Quick-pickle carrot with a splash of rice vinegar, sugar and salt.
Serve rice topped with pork, pickled carrot, cucumber and coriander.
Drizzle with sriracha.

name: Pork Ramen
description: Rich miso and soy pork broth with ramen noodles and soft eggs
instructions: Simmer pork shoulder in stock 20 mins until cooked. Remove and slice.
Soft-boil eggs 7 mins. Peel, halve.
Whisk miso and soy into the hot broth. Add sesame oil.
Cook noodles per packet.
Divide noodles into bowls, pour broth over. Top with pork, egg, bamboo shoots and spring onion.

name: Pork and Tofu Stir-fry
description: Savoury pork mince with crispy tofu in a garlicky oyster sauce
instructions: Press tofu dry, cube and pan-fry until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Brown pork mince with garlic and ginger 5 mins.
Add oyster sauce and soy. Return tofu.
Toss gently to coat. Add spring onion and stir briefly.
Serve over rice.

name: Glazed Ham with Roast Vegetables
description: Festive sweet-glazed leg ham with colourful roast vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Score ham in a diamond pattern.
Mix honey and mustard, brush over ham generously.
Cube sweet potato, halve zucchini and capsicum. Toss with oil, spread on a tray.
Roast ham 60 mins, basting every 20 mins. Add vegetables for last 40 mins.
Rest 15 mins before carving.

name: Pork Belly Bao Buns
description: Sticky braised pork belly in pillowy steamed bao buns with hoisin
instructions: Score pork belly. Mix soy, sugar and five spice, coat pork.
Roast pork belly at 200°C for 45 mins, skin side up, until crackling is golden.
Slice pork belly, slice cucumber, slice spring onion.
Steam bao buns per packet.
Spread buns with hoisin, fill with pork, cucumber, spring onion and coriander.

name: Chorizo and Chickpea Stew
description: Smoky Spanish-style stew with chorizo, chickpeas and tomatoes
instructions: Slice chorizo. Dice onion, mince garlic.
Brown chorizo in a pot, remove. Sauté onion until soft.
Add garlic, paprika, tomatoes and chickpeas. Simmer 12 mins.
Return chorizo. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Serve with crusty bread.

name: Bucatini Amatriciana
description: Roman pasta with guanciale, tomato and pecorino — full of depth
instructions: Cook bucatini al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Dice guanciale, fry in a dry pan until crispy. Remove excess fat.
Add garlic and chilli, cook 30 secs. Add wine, reduce 1 min.
Add tomatoes, simmer 15 mins.
Toss drained pasta through sauce. Add pasta water to loosen. Finish with pecorino.

name: Slow Cooker Pork Shoulder
description: Fall-apart pulled pork perfect for rolls or tacos
instructions: Mix sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Rub over pork.
Sear pork in a pan all sides. Transfer to slow cooker.
Add BBQ sauce and vinegar. Cook 7–8 hrs on low until very tender.
Shred pork with two forks, mix back through sauce.
Serve on rolls with coleslaw.

name: Grilled Salmon with Asparagus
description: Pan-seared salmon fillets with lemon butter and spring asparagus
instructions: Season salmon. Snap woody ends off asparagus.
Sear salmon skin-side down in oil 4 mins. Flip and cook 2 more mins. Set aside.
In same pan, add butter, garlic, asparagus and cook 3 mins.
Add lemon juice and capers, toss.
Serve salmon over asparagus, spoon butter sauce over. Garnish with dill.

name: Prawn Pasta
description: Quick garlic prawn pasta with cherry tomatoes and a splash of wine
instructions: Cook spaghetti al dente. Peel and devein prawns.
Sauté garlic and chilli in butter and olive oil 1 min.
Add prawns, cook 2 mins until pink. Add wine, simmer 2 mins.
Add halved cherry tomatoes, toss 1 min.
Drain pasta, add to pan with parsley. Toss and serve.

name: Thai Prawn Curry
description: Fragrant red curry with plump prawns and coconut milk
instructions: Peel and devein prawns. Slice capsicum.
Fry curry paste in a pan 2 mins.
Add coconut milk and capsicum, simmer 5 mins.
Add prawns, cook 3–4 mins until pink and cooked.
Season with fish sauce and lime. Serve over rice with basil.

name: Baked Salmon with Lemon and Capers
description: Simple oven-baked salmon with a lemon caper dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Boil potatoes 15 mins.
Place salmon on a lined baking tray. Top with lemon slices, capers, garlic and dill.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake 12–15 mins until salmon is cooked to your liking.
Serve with potatoes and salad.

name: Calamari with Aioli
description: Crispy fried calamari rings with lemon and homemade aioli
instructions: Pat squid rings dry.
Mix flour, semolina and paprika. Season.
Heat oil to 180°C.
Toss squid in flour mix. Fry in batches 2–3 mins until golden and crispy.
Drain, squeeze lemon over, serve with aioli and salad.

name: Fish Curry
description: South Indian-style fish curry with coconut milk and mustard seeds
instructions: Dice onion, mince garlic and grate ginger.
Sizzle mustard seeds in oil 30 secs. Add onion, cook until golden.
Add garlic, ginger and curry powder, cook 2 mins.
Add coconut milk, simmer 5 mins.
Add fish pieces, cook 8 mins until cooked through. Serve over rice with lime.

name: Salmon Fried Rice
description: Quick leftover-friendly fried rice with flaked salmon and egg
instructions: Cook or use leftover salmon; flake into chunks.
Stir-fry rice in a hot wok 2 mins.
Push to one side, scramble eggs. Add peas.
Add salmon, soy, sesame oil and ginger. Toss to combine.
Serve topped with spring onion.

name: Baked Barramundi with Salsa Verde
description: Crispy-skinned barramundi with a punchy Italian herb sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Season barramundi fillets.
Bake 15 mins skin-side up until cooked and skin is crispy.
Blend parsley, basil, capers, garlic, lemon juice and oil to make salsa verde.
Roast potatoes alongside or separately.
Serve fish with potatoes and a generous spoon of salsa verde.

name: Tuna Niçoise Salad
description: Classic French salad with tuna, eggs, olives and green beans
instructions: Boil eggs 8 mins for hard-boiled. Blanch beans 3 mins.
Make dressing: whisk mustard, lemon and olive oil.
Toss leaves with dressing. Arrange on a large platter.
Top with tuna, quartered eggs, beans, tomatoes and olives.
Drizzle remaining dressing over and serve.

name: Garlic Butter Prawns
description: Simple, indulgent pan-fried prawns in rich garlic butter
instructions: Peel and devein prawns. Mince garlic.
Melt butter in a large pan over high heat.
Add garlic, sauté 30 secs.
Add prawns in a single layer, cook 1–2 mins per side until pink.
Add wine and lemon juice, toss. Serve with parsley and crusty bread to mop up sauce.

name: Seafood Paella
description: Spanish-style saffron rice with prawns, mussels and calamari
instructions: Steep saffron in warm stock. Slice capsicum.
Sauté garlic and capsicum in olive oil in a wide pan.
Add rice, stir 2 mins. Add tomatoes and saffron stock.
Simmer without stirring 20 mins until rice is nearly cooked.
Arrange seafood on top, cover 8–10 mins until cooked. Serve in the pan.

name: Lemon Butter Scallops
description: Pan-seared scallops with a bright lemon butter sauce — quick and elegant
instructions: Pat scallops very dry. Season.
Heat a pan until very hot, add a little oil. Sear scallops 90 secs each side, undisturbed.
Remove scallops. Add butter and garlic, cook 1 min.
Add lemon juice and capers, swirl to combine.
Serve scallops on cauliflower puree with butter sauce and parsley.

name: Lamb Kofta with Tabbouleh
description: Herby lamb koftas served with fresh tabbouleh and lemon tahini
instructions: Prepare tabbouleh: soak bulgur per packet, mix with parsley, mint, tomato and lemon juice.
Mix lamb with garlic, cumin and half the parsley. Shape onto skewers.
Grill koftas 4 mins per side until cooked.
Make tahini sauce: mix tahini, lemon juice, garlic and water.
Serve koftas with tabbouleh and tahini drizzle.

name: Slow-Roasted Lamb Shoulder
description: Pull-apart lamb shoulder slow-roasted with garlic and rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°C. Make small incisions in lamb, push in garlic slivers and rosemary.
Season lamb all over. Sear in a roasting pan all sides.
Add wine and stock, cover tightly with foil.
Roast 3–3.5 hrs until lamb is pull-apart tender.
Rest 20 mins, shred and serve with potatoes and beans.

name: Lamb and Rosemary Stew
description: Hearty winter lamb stew with vegetables and fresh rosemary
instructions: Brown lamb in batches in oil. Set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add tomato paste, cook 1 min.
Return lamb with stock, herbs, carrot and potato.
Bring to a simmer, cover, cook 55 mins until lamb is tender.
Remove herb sprigs, season well. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Lamb Chops with Mint Sauce
description: Classic grilled lamb chops with homemade mint sauce
instructions: Finely chop mint, mix with vinegar, sugar and 2 tbsp warm water to make mint sauce.
Season lamb chops with garlic, oil and oregano.
Grill or pan-fry 3–4 mins per side for medium.
Rest 5 mins.
Serve with mint sauce, roast potatoes and peas.

name: Lamb Shank Ragù
description: Rich braised lamb shank ragù tossed through pappardelle
instructions: Season and brown lamb shanks all over. Set aside.
Sauté onion, carrot and garlic. Add wine and reduce.
Add tomatoes, rosemary and shanks. Cover, simmer 2.5 hrs until meat falls off bone.
Shred meat from shanks, stir back into sauce.
Cook pappardelle, toss with ragù. Serve with parmesan.

name: Lamb Tagine with Preserved Lemon
description: Moroccan-spiced slow-cooked lamb with preserved lemon and olives
instructions: Brown lamb pieces. Set aside.
Sauté onion with ras el hanout and garlic. Add honey.
Return lamb with 250ml water and sliced preserved lemon. Cover, simmer 70 mins.
Add olives for final 15 mins.
Serve over couscous with fresh coriander.

name: Lamb Moussaka
description: Greek-style baked eggplant and lamb mince with béchamel topping
instructions: Slice eggplant, salt 10 mins, rinse and dry. Brush with oil, grill until golden.
Brown lamb with onion, garlic and cinnamon. Add tomatoes, simmer 15 mins.
Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk until thick.
Layer eggplant, lamb, eggplant in a baking dish. Top with béchamel and parmesan.
Bake 35–40 mins at 180°C until golden.

name: Lamb and Chickpea Curry
description: Warming spiced lamb and chickpea curry with yoghurt
instructions: Brown lamb pieces. Set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and garam masala.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas and lamb. Simmer 35 mins.
Stir in yoghurt off the heat.
Serve over rice with coriander.

name: Greek Lamb Chops with Salad
description: Simply seasoned lamb chops with a classic Greek salad
instructions: Season lamb cutlets with oregano, oil and lemon zest.
Grill or pan-fry 3 mins per side for medium-rare.
Combine tomato, cucumber, onion, olives and feta with oil and lemon juice.
Rest lamb 3 mins.
Serve lamb alongside salad.

name: Lamb and Pumpkin Curry
description: Rich curry with sweet pumpkin and tender lamb — great batch cook
instructions: Cube lamb and pumpkin. Dice onion, mince garlic and grate ginger.
Brown lamb. Sauté onion with garlic, ginger and curry powder.
Add coconut milk, pumpkin and lamb. Simmer 35 mins.
Serve over rice with fresh coriander.

name: Lamb Flatbread Pizza
description: Quick flatbread pizzas topped with spiced lamb, pine nuts and yoghurt
instructions: Brown lamb mince with diced onion, allspice and cumin.
Preheat oven to 220°C.
Spread lamb over flatbreads. Top with pine nuts.
Bake 10 mins until crispy.
Top with yoghurt, sliced tomato and parsley. Squeeze lemon over.

name: Slow-Braised Lamb Neck
description: Meltingly tender braised lamb neck with Mediterranean vegetables
instructions: Brown lamb neck chops all sides. Set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic, eggplant and zucchini 5 mins.
Add wine, tomatoes and thyme. Return lamb.
Cover and simmer on low 2.5 hrs until meat is falling off bone.
Serve with steamed rice.

name: Shakshuka with Feta
description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce topped with creamy feta
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add spices and chilli, cook 1 min.
Add tomatoes, simmer 10 mins until slightly thickened.
Make 8 wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each.
Crumble feta over. Cover and cook 7–10 mins until whites are set.
Serve directly from pan with crusty bread.

name: Vegetable Thai Green Curry
description: Creamy coconut green curry packed with seasonal vegetables
instructions: Press and cube tofu. Pan-fry until golden, set aside.
Fry curry paste 2 mins. Add coconut milk, bring to simmer.
Add broccoli and capsicum, cook 5 mins.
Add tofu and zucchini, simmer 3 mins. Season with soy.
Serve over rice with thai basil.

name: Falafel Wraps with Hummus
description: Crispy chickpea falafel in flatbread with hummus and salad
instructions: Drain chickpeas. Blend with garlic, cumin, coriander and parsley — pulse to rough texture.
Shape into balls, refrigerate 15 mins.
Pan-fry or bake at 200°C until golden and crispy.
Warm flatbreads. Spread with hummus.
Fill with falafel, sliced tomato, cucumber and a drizzle of tahini.

name: Lentil Dal with Naan
description: Comforting red lentil dal with aromatics served with warm naan
instructions: Rinse lentils. Dice onion, mince garlic, grate ginger.
Sauté onion until golden. Add garlic, ginger and garam masala, cook 2 mins.
Add tomatoes, lentils and coconut milk. Simmer 20–25 mins, stirring often.
Season well.
Warm naan. Serve dal topped with coriander and serve naan alongside.

name: Mushroom and Spinach Frittata
description: Hearty baked frittata with mushrooms, spinach and melted cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Sauté onion, garlic and mushrooms until golden.
Add spinach, stir until wilted.
Whisk eggs with milk and cheese. Season well.
Pour egg mix over vegetables in an ovenproof pan.
Bake 15–18 mins until set and golden. Slice and serve.

name: Black Bean Tacos
description: Smoky black bean filling in warm tortillas with all the toppings
instructions: Drain and rinse beans. Heat with cumin and paprika until warmed through.
Warm tortillas. Mash avocado with lime juice and salt.
Char corn kernels in a dry pan.
Fill tortillas with beans, avocado, charred corn, red onion and cheese.
Add sour cream and a squeeze of lime.

name: Pumpkin and Sage Pasta
description: Creamy roasted pumpkin pasta with crispy fried sage — autumn comfort
instructions: Cube pumpkin, roast at 200°C with oil and garlic 25 mins until soft and golden.
Cook pasta al dente.
Blitz roasted pumpkin with cream and pasta water until smooth.
Fry sage leaves in butter until crispy.
Toss pasta with pumpkin sauce. Serve topped with crispy sage and parmesan.
