name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
description: Simple weeknight chickpea curry with spinach and warming spices
instructions: Dice onion, mince garlic, grate ginger.
Sauté onion until golden. Add garlic, ginger and curry powder, cook 2 mins.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk. Simmer 12 mins.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Serve over rice.

name: Veggie Quesadillas
description: Crispy quesadillas loaded with beans, capsicum and melted cheese
instructions: Drain beans. Dice capsicum.
Mix beans, capsicum and corn.
Scatter bean mix and cheese over half of each tortilla. Fold.
Cook quesadillas in a dry pan 2–3 mins per side until golden.
Serve with sour cream, salsa and sliced avocado.

name: Tofu Pad Thai
description: Authentic-style pad thai with tofu, eggs and tamarind sauce
instructions: Soak noodles per packet. Press and cube tofu, fry until golden.
Mix tamarind, soy and sugar into a sauce.
Stir-fry tofu in hot wok. Push to sides, scramble eggs.
Add drained noodles and sauce, toss until coated.
Add bean sprouts, serve with peanuts, spring onion and lime.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Layers of crumbed eggplant, rich tomato sauce and melted cheese
instructions: Slice eggplant 5mm thick. Salt, rest 10 mins, rinse and dry.
Coat eggplant in egg then breadcrumbs. Shallow-fry until golden both sides.
Mix passata with garlic and basil.
Layer in baking dish: sauce, eggplant, cheese, repeat. Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 30 mins at 180°C until bubbling and golden.

name: Lentil Bolognese
description: Rich, meaty-textured lentil sauce over spaghetti — vegan comfort food
instructions: Dice all vegetables. Cook lentils per packet until tender, drain.
Sauté onion, carrot and celery 8 mins until soft. Add garlic.
Stir in tomato paste, cook 2 mins. Add crushed tomatoes and oregano.
Add lentils, simmer 15 mins. Season generously.
Cook spaghetti. Serve with bolognese sauce.

name: Mexican Black Bean Rice Bowl
description: Colourful vegan rice bowl with black beans, guacamole and salsa
instructions: Warm beans with cumin, salt and pepper.
Char corn in a dry pan.
Mash avocado with lime juice.
Divide rice into bowls. Top with beans, corn, tomatoes and guacamole.
Squeeze over lime, top with coriander and optional sour cream.

name: Caprese Pasta Salad
description: Fresh pasta tossed with tomato, mozzarella and basil — summer essential
instructions: Cook pasta al dente. Rinse under cold water to cool.
Halve tomatoes, tear mozzarella.
Toss pasta with oil, garlic, tomatoes and mozzarella.
Season well. Add basil leaves.
Drizzle with balsamic and serve at room temperature.

name: Vegetarian Chilli
description: Hearty three-bean chilli with corn and smoky paprika
instructions: Drain and rinse all beans. Dice onion, mince garlic.
Sauté onion until soft. Add garlic and spices, cook 2 mins.
Add tomatoes, beans and corn. Stir well.
Simmer 20 mins, stirring occasionally. Season well.
Serve with sour cream, cheese and corn chips.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
description: Creamy roasted pumpkin stirred through velvety risotto
instructions: Cube pumpkin, roast at 200°C 25 mins. Warm stock.
Sauté onion until soft. Add garlic and rice, stir 1 min. Add wine.
Add stock ladle by ladle, stirring constantly 20–25 mins.
Mash half the pumpkin, stir through risotto. Add remaining chunks.
Stir in butter and parmesan. Fry sage in butter, garnish on top.

name: French Onion Soup
description: Rich caramelised onion soup with gruyère toast on top
instructions: Thinly slice onions. Melt butter in a heavy pot.
Cook onions on medium-low 40 mins, stirring often, until deep golden and caramelised.
Add garlic, wine and thyme. Stir well.
Add stock, simmer 15 mins. Season.
Ladle into ovenproof bowls. Top with baguette slices and gruyère. Grill until bubbling.

name: Minestrone Soup
description: Classic Italian vegetable and bean soup with pasta
instructions: Dice all vegetables. Mince garlic.
Sauté onion, carrot and celery 5 mins. Add garlic.
Add tomatoes, stock and beans. Simmer 15 mins.
Add zucchini and pasta, cook 10 mins until pasta is tender.
Season, serve topped with parmesan.

name: Spanakopita
description: Flaky Greek pastry filled with spinach and feta — vegetarian classic
instructions: Squeeze all liquid from spinach. Mix with crumbled feta, eggs and nutmeg.
Sauté onion and garlic, add to spinach mix.
Brush a baking dish with oil. Layer 4 filo sheets, brushing each with oil.
Spread spinach filling evenly. Top with remaining filo sheets, brushed with oil.
Score top, bake at 180°C for 40 mins until golden and crispy.

name: Leek and Gruyère Tart
description: Buttery short-crust tart filled with sweet leeks and melted gruyère
instructions: Line a tart tin with pastry, chill 15 mins. Blind bake at 190°C 15 mins.
Slice leeks, sauté in butter until soft 10 mins. Season.
Whisk eggs, cream and thyme.
Spread mustard on pastry base. Add leeks and grated gruyère.
Pour egg mix over. Bake 25 mins until set and golden.

name: Roasted Vegetable Pasta
description: Baked seasonal vegetables tossed through pasta with herbs and parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cube all vegetables, toss with oil and garlic.
Roast 25 mins until golden and soft.
Cook pasta al dente.
Toss pasta with roasted vegetables, including any juices.
Serve topped with parmesan and fresh basil.

name: Bean and Vegetable Soup
description: Nourishing mix-bean soup with seasonal vegetables — batch-cook favourite
instructions: Dice vegetables, mince garlic. Drain and rinse beans.
Sauté onion, carrot and celery 5 mins.
Add garlic, cumin, stock and beans.
Simmer 20 mins. Add spinach, cook 2 mins.
Season well, serve with crusty bread.

name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-fry
description: Crispy tofu with colourful vegetables in a savory oyster-style sauce
instructions: Press tofu dry, cube. Pan-fry until golden all over. Set aside.
Chop all vegetables.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger 30 secs. Add vegetables, cook 4 mins.
Return tofu, add soy and hoisin. Toss to combine.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Cheese and Herb Omelette
description: Classic French-style omelette with gruyère and fresh herbs
instructions: Beat 2 eggs with a splash of milk and herbs per person.
Heat butter in a small pan over medium heat.
Pour in egg mix. Gently move with a spatula as edges set.
When nearly set, scatter grated gruyère over half. Fold over.
Slide onto plate. Repeat for remaining portions. Serve with salad.

name: Egg and Veggie Breakfast Burrito
description: Loaded morning burrito with scrambled eggs, beans and fresh salsa
instructions: Scramble eggs to your liking.
Warm beans, dice capsicum.
Warm tortillas. Layer with scrambled eggs, beans, capsicum and cheese.
Add avocado slices, salsa and sour cream.
Roll up tightly and serve.

name: Duck Breast with Orange Sauce
description: Pan-seared duck breast with a bright citrus pan sauce
instructions: Score duck skin. Season.
Start duck skin-side down in cold pan, render fat slowly 10 mins. Flip 3 mins. Rest.
Drain most fat. Add orange juice, honey, vinegar and stock.
Simmer 5 mins to make sauce.
Serve sliced duck with sauce, roast potatoes and green beans.

name: Prosciutto and Rocket Pizza
description: Thin-base pizza with prosciutto, rocket and parmesan — no cooking needed for toppings
instructions: Preheat oven to 230°C.
Spread sauce over bases. Scatter mozzarella.
Bake 10–12 mins until crispy and cheese is golden.
Remove from oven. Top with prosciutto and rocket.
Shave parmesan over, drizzle with balsamic. Slice and serve.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagels
description: Loaded bagels with smoked salmon, cream cheese and capers
instructions: Slice bagels and toast.
Spread cream cheese generously on each half.
Layer smoked salmon over cream cheese.
Top with thinly sliced red onion, cucumber, capers and dill.
Squeeze lemon over and serve.

name: Chicken and Prawn Pad Thai
description: Restaurant-style pad thai with both chicken and prawn
instructions: Soak noodles per packet. Slice chicken into strips.
Stir-fry chicken 3 mins, add prawns, cook until pink. Set aside.
Scramble eggs in wok. Add drained noodles and sauce.
Return protein. Add bean sprouts, toss through.
Serve topped with peanuts, spring onion and lime.

name: Aussie Mixed Grill
description: Classic barbecue plate with steak, sausage, chop and salad
instructions: Cook potato wedges at 220°C for 30 mins.
Heat BBQ or grill pan.
Cook steak to preference. Cook sausages 12 mins, turning. Cook chops 4 mins per side.
Grill bacon until crispy.
Serve mixed grill platter with wedges, coleslaw and tomato sauce.

name: Bibimbap
description: Korean rice bowl with vegetables, beef and gochujang sauce
instructions: Brown beef with soy and sesame oil. Separately sauté each vegetable with seasoning.
Blanch spinach, squeeze dry and season.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Divide rice into bowls. Arrange vegetables and beef in sections on top.
Place egg in centre. Serve with gochujang stirred in at table.

name: Japanese Chicken Ramen
description: Shoyu-style chicken ramen with soft egg and nori
instructions: Soft-boil eggs 7 mins, cool and peel.
Simmer chicken in stock 15 mins. Remove, slice thinly.
Season broth with soy and mirin.
Cook noodles per packet.
Assemble: noodles in bowls, ladle broth over, top with chicken, halved egg, nori and spring onion.

name: Vietnamese Chicken Pho
description: Fragrant star anise broth with rice noodles and poached chicken
instructions: Simmer stock with star anise and ginger 20 mins. Strain.
Poach chicken breast in the broth 15 mins. Remove and shred.
Season broth with fish sauce.
Soak noodles per packet.
Serve noodles in bowls topped with chicken and hot broth. Garnish with herbs, sprouts and lime.

name: Prawn and Avocado Salad
description: Light, fresh salad with juicy prawns and creamy avocado
instructions: Peel prawns if needed.
Slice avocado and cucumber. Halve tomatoes.
Whisk lemon juice, oil and mustard into a dressing.
Toss leaves with dressing.
Arrange salad on a plate, top with prawns, avocado, tomato and cucumber.

name: Tuna Melt Sandwich
description: Classic American tuna melt on sourdough with melted cheese
instructions: Drain tuna. Mix with mayo, mustard, diced celery and onion.
Spread tuna mix on 4 bread slices.
Top with cheddar slices.
Grill open-faced until cheese is melted and golden.
Top with remaining bread, slice and serve.

name: Club Sandwich
description: Triple-decker toasted sandwich packed with chicken, bacon and salad
instructions: Cook chicken and bacon. Slice chicken.
Toast bread slices.
Spread mayo on all slices.
Build first layer: bread, lettuce, tomato, bacon.
Add second bread slice, then chicken, cheese and avocado. Top and secure with toothpick. Cut into triangles.

name: Veal Scallopine
description: Thin veal escalopes in a rich lemon and white wine sauce
instructions: Pound veal very thin. Season and dust in flour.
Pan-fry in butter 1–2 mins per side until just golden.
Remove veal. Deglaze with wine, add lemon juice and capers.
Swirl in more butter to make sauce.
Serve veal with sauce and pasta or mash.

name: Seafood Fried Rice
description: Wok-fried rice with prawns, squid and egg in soy sauce
instructions: Heat wok over very high heat with oil.
Stir-fry seafood 2 mins until cooked. Set aside.
Add garlic and peas, cook 1 min. Push to side, scramble eggs.
Add rice, toss and fry 2 mins.
Return seafood, add sauces, toss to combine. Serve with spring onion.

name: Beef Yakitori Skewers
description: Japanese-style chargrilled beef skewers with a teriyaki glaze
instructions: Cube beef. Mix soy, mirin, sake and sugar into a marinade.
Thread beef and spring onion alternately onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry, brushing regularly with marinade, 8 mins total.
Rest 2 mins.
Serve over rice scattered with sesame seeds.

name: Salmon and Avocado Sushi Bowl
description: Deconstructed sushi bowl with sashimi salmon and avocado on rice
instructions: Cook sushi rice per packet, season with rice vinegar and sugar.
Slice salmon into thin pieces. Slice avocado and cucumber.
Snip nori into thin strips.
Divide rice into bowls.
Arrange salmon, avocado, cucumber and nori on top. Drizzle soy over. Finish with sesame seeds.

name: Turkish Chicken Kebabs
description: Marinated chicken thighs grilled on skewers with flatbread and salad
instructions: Mix yoghurt, garlic, paprika and cumin. Coat chicken thighs, marinate 30+ mins.
Thread chicken onto skewers.
Grill 6–7 mins per side until slightly charred and cooked through.
Warm flatbread. Make a simple salad with tomato, cucumber and onion.
Serve kebabs with flatbread and salad.

name: Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Rice
description: One-pan saffron rice with chicken and chorizo — paella-style
instructions: Brown chicken thighs and chorizo. Set aside.
Sauté garlic and capsicum. Add saffron, paprika and rice, stir 1 min.
Add tomatoes and stock. Return chicken and chorizo on top.
Simmer without stirring 25–30 mins until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 mins, serve from the pan.

name: Beef Birria Tacos
description: Slow-braised Mexican beef in corn tacos with consommé for dipping
instructions: Toast and rehydrate chillies. Blend with tomatoes, garlic and cumin to a sauce.
Brown beef. Add sauce and 500ml water. Braise 2+ hrs until very tender.
Shred beef. Reserve braising liquid as consommé.
Dip tortillas in consommé, fill with beef and cheese, fold.
Pan-fry folded tacos until crispy. Serve with coriander and consommé for dipping.

name: Lamb and Eggplant Bake
description: Middle Eastern inspired lamb and eggplant bake with yoghurt topping
instructions: Slice eggplant, brush with oil, roast at 200°C 20 mins until golden.
Brown lamb with onion, garlic and spices. Add tomatoes, simmer 15 mins.
Layer eggplant and lamb sauce in a baking dish, ending with eggplant.
Spread yoghurt over top. Scatter pine nuts.
Bake 25 mins at 180°C until golden. Serve with rice or flatbread.

name: Tofu and Mushroom Ramen
description: Vegetarian Japanese ramen with miso broth, crispy tofu and soft egg
instructions: Soft-boil eggs 7 mins. Cube and pan-fry tofu until crispy. Slice mushrooms.
Bring stock to a simmer. Whisk in miso and soy sauce.
Add mushrooms and spinach to broth, cook 3 mins.
Cook noodles per packet.
Serve noodles in bowls with broth, tofu, halved eggs and sesame oil.

name: Warm Chickpea Salad Bowl
description: Hearty roasted chickpea salad with tahini dressing
instructions: Drain chickpeas, toss with oil and paprika. Roast at 200°C 20 mins until crispy.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic and water into a dressing.
Arrange greens, tomatoes and cucumber in bowls.
Top with hot roasted chickpeas.
Drizzle tahini dressing over and serve.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Pasta
description: Lean turkey meatballs in marinara sauce over spaghetti
instructions: Mix turkey mince, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic and oregano. Roll into meatballs.
Brown meatballs in oil 5 mins, turning.
Add passata, bring to a simmer, cover 20 mins.
Cook spaghetti per packet.
Serve meatballs in sauce over pasta with parmesan and basil.

name: Prawn and Corn Chowder
description: Creamy Australian-style chowder with sweet corn and plump prawns
instructions: Peel and devein prawns. Dice potato and onion.
Melt butter, sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add potato and stock, simmer 12 mins until potato is cooked.
Add corn and cream, simmer 3 mins.
Add prawns, cook 3 mins until pink. Season. Serve with parsley and bread.
